title: Seven-day flood forecasts with reliability similar to earlier five-day forecasts
summary: The new model, trained on 15,980 stations (up from 5,680), gives seven-day reliability comparable to the previous model's five-day forecast. Flood Hub covers over 100 countries and about 700 million people (up from 460 million). About 250,000 virtual points are unverified and intended for experts only; flash, urban, and coastal floods remain out of scope. The linked March 2024 Nature paper describes the predecessor model, also covered by the catalog's March entry; the November performance and coverage update is reported in this Google Research announcement.
